description.zh: 自定义回落内容。该参数为国际站配置参数，中国站可忽略此参数。
description.en: The custom fallback content. This parameter is for the China site (Chinese). China site users can ignore this parameter.

description.zh: 回落触发时间。此参数为国际站参数，中国站可忽略此参数。<props="intl">消息在指定时间内没有返回已到达回执消息时进行回落, 不填代表不根据此时间判断回落，只有发送失败和有失败的状态报告时才会回落。单位：秒。最小值：60，最大值：43200。</props>
description.en: The fallback trigger time. This parameter is for the international site. China site users can ignore this parameter. <props="intl">If no delivery receipt is returned within the specified time, the fallback is triggered. If this parameter is not specified, the fallback is triggered only when the message fails to send or a failure status report is received. Unit: seconds. Minimum value: 60. Maximum value: 43200.</props>

description.zh: 回落策略ID。该参数为国际站配置参数，中国站可忽略此参数。<props="intl">在[**回落策略**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/FallbackStrategy)界面查看策略ID。</props>
description.en: The fallback policy ID. This parameter is for the China site (Chinese). China site users can ignore this parameter. <props="intl">You can view the policy ID on the [**Fallback Policy**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/FallbackStrategy) page.</props>

description.zh:
回落规则。此参数为国际站参数，中国站可忽略此参数。
</props><props="intl">取值：</props>
<props="intl">- **undelivered**：消息不能发送到端时进行回落（在发送状态时模板、参数需要校验通过，模板被封、号码被封等不做校验）。参数值为空时默认使用此规则。</props>
<props="intl">-  **sentFailed**：消息在校验模板、模板变量等参数时，校验不通过也会进行回落。只会强校验channelType, type, messageType, to, from(是否存在) 几个参数。</props>
description.en:
The fallback rule. This parameter is for the international site. China site users can ignore this parameter.
</props><props="intl">Valid values:</props>
<props="intl">- **undelivered**: the fallback is triggered when the message cannot be delivered to the device. During sending, the template and parameters must pass validation. Blocked templates or blocked numbers are not validated. This rule is used by default if the parameter value is empty.</props>
<props="intl">- **sentFailed**: the fallback is triggered when validation of the template or template variables fails. Only channelType, type, messageType, to, and from (whether it exists) are strictly validated.</props>

- 当ChannelType为**instagram**时为instagram专业账户ID（Account ID）。在<props="china">[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>>**管理**>**专业账户**界面查看。
<props="intl">- 当ChannelType为**viber**时为Viber服务号ID（Service ID）。在[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)>**管理**>**服务号管理**界面查看。</props>

- If ChannelType is **messenger**, this is the Page ID. You can view it on the <props="china">[**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> > **Management** > **Public Page** page.
- If ChannelType is **instagram**, this is the Instagram professional Account ID. You can view it on the <props="china">[**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> > **Management** > **Professional Account** page.
<props="intl">- If ChannelType is **viber**, this is the Viber Service ID. You can view it on the [**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList) > **Management** > **Service ID Management** page.</props>

The recipient phone number.

- If ChannelType is **whatsapp**, this is the phone number of the message recipient.
- If ChannelType is **messenger**, this is the Page-Scoped User ID generated when the user interacts with the Facebook page.
- If ChannelType is **instagram**, this is the Instagram User ID generated when the user interacts with the Instagram business or creator account.
<props="intl">- If ChannelType is **viber**, this is the phone number of the message recipient.</props>

title.en: Send chat app messages in batches

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用此接口批量发送消息，也可在<props="china">[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>>**管理**>**消息发送**界面手动批量发送消息。

- 在调用此接口前。请确保您已成功创建通道，且已有审核通过的模板。

- WhatsApp通道类型需已完成[WABA注册及绑定](~~172335~~)、[新增号码](~~2656131~~)。
- Messenger通道类型需已完成[连接公共主页账号](~~2837713~~)。
- Instagram通道类型需已完成[连接专业账户账号](~~2837720~~)。

<props="intl">- Viber通道类型需已完成[申请服务号](~~2807995~~)。</props>

### QPS限制
- 本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。

- 单次请求支持最多1,000个号码。

### 状态变更
消息发送状态可以通过MNS/HTTP方式监听，具体请参考[回执消息](~~421545~~)。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to send messages in batches. You can also manually send messages in batches on the <props="china">[**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> > **Management** > **Message Sending** page.

- Before calling this operation, make sure that you have created a channel and have an approved template.

- For WhatsApp channels, complete [WABA registration and bindng](~~172335~~) and [add a phone number](~~2656131~~).
- For Messenger channels, complete [connecting a public page account](~~2837713~~).
- For Instagram channels, complete [connecting a professional account](~~2837720~~).

<props="intl">- For Viber channels, complete [applying for a service ID](~~2807995~~).</props>

### QPS limit
- The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation as appropriate.

- A maximum of 1,000 phone numbers are supported per request.

### Status changes
You can monitor message sending status through MNS or HTTP. For more information, see [Receipt messages](~~421545~~).
